name: context-ontology-companion
description: Save and recover explicitly selected project context locally with provenance and revision history.

interface.longDescription: Store, retrieve, correct, revoke and erase explicitly selected project decisions and constraints on your own computer. Includes project-scoped local MCP setup and a Python 3.11+ CLI. Preserves sources, revisions and caller-declared OS-account authorization; stored context never authorizes later actions.
